senses.gloss: to polish, furbish; to clarify, make clear.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 84a:14">B. Mets. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>משיְצַחְצְחָן במים</he> arms are considered finished, when the smith has furbished (steeled) them by putting them in cold water.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 33a:3-4">R. Hash. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>מים … כדי לצַחְצְחוֹ</he> you may pour water or wine into the Shofar to make its sound clear.

<cite ref="Niddah 25b:1">Nidd. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>מְצַחְצְחוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="I00712"><he>טָרַד</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְצוּחְצָח</he>; f. <he>מְצוּחְצֶחֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְצוּחְצָהִין</he>; <he>מְצוּחְצָחוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:12">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00280"><he>צִחְצוּחַ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 2:7:3">Y. Nidd. II, 50ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>במְצַחְצֵחַ</he> when the blood is clear (fluid). Ib.ᵇ top, opp. <he>מקדיר</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>אפי׳ מְצַחְצְחִין</he> even when the blood is clear.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1">Deut. R. s. 1</cite> <he>לשונו … ומצַחְצְחָה מיד וכ׳</he> his tongue is cured and speaks at once clearly in teaching the words of the Law.
